title: One pane as a die set
label: Die set: a ruled base on round feet holds the contoured picture bed; four threaded pillars with hex nuts carry a stippled frosted copy, a ringed distance field and an inked glass slab. A 2D canvas card stands in a holder, wired to a pillar.
caption: A frosted pane is drawn in layers: a blurred copy of the picture, a distance field for the box, then the glass that bends light only in its bezel, and the result is copied into a 2D canvas. Move across the figure to close or spread the layers.
